primary_metric: correlated SYN/ACK SACK permission (HZ-001); A/A SACK discordance (HZ-002)

gates.note: A false positive is any inferred SACK difference on a SACK-disabled endpoint or any A/A run. Loss-jitter strata have no registered resolved outcome: unresolved is acceptable, a difference on a null is not.

limitations: All namespaces share one Linux kernel inside one Docker VM; runs are not independent hosts.
Netem randomness is not reproduced by the ordering seed.
RTT is the HORIZON userspace clock; intervals assume independent pairs.
Small per-stratum counts bound false-positive rates only loosely; the synthetic protocol calibrates the decision rules.
